title: Position: Editing Large Language Models Poses Serious Safety Risks

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed as a malicious use case where attackers can use Knowledge Editing (KE) methods (e.g., ROME, IKE) to inject gender-biased sentences into models, which has been shown in cited literature to increase bias in general model outputs.
Discussed as a vulnerability category for malicious bias injection attacks using Knowledge Editing (KE) methods, based on prior empirical literature.
